## Study description


In each of 5 reps 25 1/10 acre circular plots were planted with 34 1-0 (1 year old) Douglas fir seedlings. 5 plots per rep were  each assigned to a treatment: DF0Y, RA10Y, CW10Y, RA20Y, CW20Y. (plots = 125, tmt = 5, rep = 5, plots/tmt/rep = 5). 34 seedlings/plot = approx 4,250 trees.   

## Loading libraries

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Importing data
Two multi-sheet workboooks were provided by Anna Leon of Weyerhauser (Anna.Leon@weyerhaeuser.com). One with keys for metadata codes and one with coded data plus a dictionary for column names

```{r, message=FALSE}
colnames(Status_codes)<-c("Status_Code","Status")

colnames(Position_codes)<-c("Position_Code","Position")

colnames(Data_dict)<-c("Column_Name","Description")

#reading in data
A_plots <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/raw_data/data_input_edits.xlsx",sheet = "A-Plots", col_names = TRUE)
#unique(A_plots$AMT1)
A_plots$AMT1[A_plots$AMT1==0]<-NA

B_plots <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/raw_data/data_input_edits.xlsx",sheet = "B-Plots", col_names = TRUE)

C_plots <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/raw_data/data_input_edits.xlsx",sheet = "C-Plots", col_names = TRUE)
#checking nonconforming trt entries with "y" instead of "Y"
#unique(C_plots$TRT)
C_plots$TRT[C_plots$TRT=="DF0y"]<-"DF0Y"

D_plots <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/raw_data/data_input_edits.xlsx",sheet = "D-Plots", col_names = TRUE)
#checking nonconforming trt entries with "y" instead of "Y"
#unique(D_plots$TRT)
#unique(D_plots$DAM1)
#unique(D_plots$AMT1)
D_plots$TRT[D_plots$TRT=="RA20y"]<-"RA20Y"
D_plots$DAM1[D_plots$DAM1=="Blank"]<-NA
D_plots$AMT1[D_plots$AMT1=="Blank"]<-NA

E_plots <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/raw_data/data_input_edits.xlsx",sheet = "E-Plots", col_names = TRUE)

#combine all treatments together into one dataset and change coded variables to factors rather than numbers
combined_data<-rbind(A_plots,B_plots,C_plots,D_plots,E_plots)
#unique(combined_data$TRT)
combined_data$LOC<-as.factor(combined_data$LOC)
combined_data$PLOT<-as.factor(combined_data$PLOT)
combined_data$SUBPLOT<-as.factor(combined_data$SUBPLOT)
combined_data$REP<-as.factor(combined_data$REP)
combined_data$TRT<-as.factor(combined_data$TRT)
combined_data$TREE<-as.factor(combined_data$TREE)
combined_data$SP<-as.factor(combined_data$SP)
combined_data$OR<-as.factor(combined_data$OR)
combined_data$OSTS<-as.factor(combined_data$OSTS)
combined_data$NSTS<-as.factor(combined_data$NSTS)
combined_data$DAM1<-as.factor(combined_data$DAM1)
combined_data$POS1<-as.factor(combined_data$POS1)
combined_data$AMT1<-as.factor(combined_data$AMT1)

#removing false zeros for DBH measurements
combined_data$NDBH[combined_data$NDBH==0]<-NA
combined_data$ODBH[combined_data$ODBH==0]<-NA

#saveRDS(combined_data, file="C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/raw_data/combined_trt_data.Rds")

#write.csv(combined_data, file="C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/raw_data/combined_trt_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

##Remaining questions
Note says that DF tretament "C" was 45 years old in 2020.Thus, plots were established in 1975.  All treatments were started at the same time follwing clearcut. DF in 10 year roation treatments are 35 (45-10) years old and in 20 year treatments 25 (45-20) years old.

Mike indicated that there were 34 trees planted in each of the cicular observation subplots.

To what year(s) do(es) the "old" measurements in the provided data refer?

Are there any additional useful maps? Anna?

11 trees without NDBH measurements. Are they duplicated in other plots? Remove them? No, they are dead (or one fused trunk).

Randomization/exp design.  RCB?
Is there a stem map and/or do the tree numbers refer to a position in the subplot?
